# Vendored dependency

JSON for Modern C++ (`nlohmann/json`), **v3.12.0**, MIT license. Only the official
single header and its license are included. Builds require no package download.

- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/LICENSE.MIT
- Integration documentation: https://json.nlohmann.me/integration/

SHA-256 of the downloaded files:

```text
aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63  nlohmann/json.hpp
46a65cffd1ea955132d95a8dd921640714a8d6b537d2e4e482d31145ae95b603  nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT
```

The dependency is private to the JSON implementation; public core headers do
not expose its types.
